method: GT frozen before parser inspection. All87 source pages visually inventoried; ChineseBERT and fractional-wave deep review compares every scientific object against full300DPI crops, allCSV/HTML exports and20 independently selected cells. Five other papers remain inventory_only; no blanket crop/cell correctness claims for them. No baseline edits or reparse.

field_semantics.crop_complete: All scientific body content present; clean_separate_crop additionally excludes merged or oversized captures. A merged resource may cover two logical objects but remains defective.
field_semantics.caption_association: Association, not perfect text fidelity. Mathematical Unicode/source-layer loss is reported separately.
field_semantics.inventory_only: Numbered labels/pages compared to metadata; crop_complete and detailed cell accuracy are not graded.
field_semantics.sample_cell_status: exact string at the semantic row/column in JSON+CSV+expandedHTML; numeric sign normalization is allowed only where preregistered.
field_semantics.auxiliary: Logos, ORCID badges and page furniture are excluded from scientific counts.

objects.auto_caption: Figure 1 Models are encoded and passed down the pipeline using a symbolic expression tree data-structure. Leafs in the tree represent parameters, variables, matrices etc., while internal nodes represent either basic operators such multiplication or division, or continuous operators such as divergence or gradients.

Figure 2 PyBaMM is designed around a pipeline approach. Models are initially defined using mathematical expressions encoded as expression trees. These models are then passed to a class which sets the parameters of the model, before being discretised into linear algebra expressions, and finally solved using a time-stepping class.

Figure 3 Interactive visualisation of solutions. The user can select the time at which to view the output using the time-slider bar at the bottom. This interactive plot is automatically generated by providing a list of model solutions and output variables.

objects.auto_caption: Figure 2: An overview of inducing the glyph embedding. ⊗ denotes vector concatenation. summary.quality_conclusion: Workflow integrity succeeds but extraction quality is not globally correct. Deep review identifies ChineseBERT merged figures1/2, missing figure3 and a blank crop, caption contamination; fractional-wave Figure4 loses three panels, equation41 is misclassified as a table, and scientific table notation/headers lose meaning. Five inventory-only papers have no blanket crop/cell pass. English-with-Chinese is not full Chinese-language coverage.
